title: External & Financial Constraint
dek: How reserves, external flows, debt obligations, market access, and the depth of domestic finance shape Argentina's capacity to absorb shocks and finance growth.
intro: Argentina's external constraint is not one number. Gross reserves can rise while usable buffers remain thin; a trade surplus can coexist with service and interest outflows; market access can improve while refinancing needs remain large. This area organizes those pieces into a common reading structure, separating stocks from flows and distinguishing temporary financing support from durable improvements in external resilience.
